description: Extension of ChannelsStore class providing lifecycle management functions including start, stop, refresh, and WhatsApp/Telegram login/logout operations; contains helper structs for decoding login results and logout responses.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes a polling task that periodically refreshes channel status unless in preview mode.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Cancels the polling task and resets it to nil.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the latest channel status snapshot from the gateway, updates internal state, and handles errors.

methods.name: startWhatsAppLogin
methods.description: Starts WhatsApp login process, optionally auto-waiting for completion based on QR code availability.

methods.name: waitWhatsAppLogin
methods.description: Waits for WhatsApp login to complete within a specified timeout.

methods.name: logoutWhatsApp
methods.description: Logs out and clears credentials for WhatsApp channel.

methods.name: logoutTelegram
methods.description: Logs out Telegram channel and updates configuration status.
